label: S7-1500 CPU 1516-3 PN/DP
description: High-end PLC (6ES7516-3AN02-0AB0) with three gigabit RJ45 ports: X1 is a two-port PROFINET IRT switch and X2 is a separate single-port PROFINET RT interface, so 3 x 1 Gbit/s Ethernet in total. A third interface is PROFIBUS DP on a 9-pin sub-D, not Ethernet; integrated web server.
